a: SSRF makes your server request attacker-chosen URLs, often hitting internal systems.
Blocklists miss aliases; prefer allowlists of hosts.
Resolve DNS and validate IPs again at connect time to reduce rebinding.
Allow only https (and http if required); block file/gopher/etc.
Put egress-capable workers in restricted networks.
Do not reflect raw internal responses to users.
Short timeouts and size limits reduce damage.
Test with internal IPs, DNS tricks, and redirect chains in staging.
